questions.question: What occasion lies behind Psalm 51?
options: When Nathan confronted David after he had gone in to Bathsheba
When David spared the life of Saul as he slept in the dark cave
When David fled away from the face of Absalom his rebellious son
When David brought the ark of the covenant up into Jerusalem
questions.answer: When Nathan confronted David after he had gone in to Bathsheba

questions.question: What does David ask God to create in him?
options: A clean heart and a right spirit
A long life and very many children
questions.answer: A clean heart and a right spirit

questions.question: David says God will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
Create in me a clean _____, O God.
Wash me, and I shall be whiter than _____.
